hero.the-lost-tales.addran.biography: General Addran is a leader extremely respected by his soldiers for his courage and unwavering loyalty to the royal family.He never hesitated to go to the front with his men, his numerous scars attest to this.
hero.the-lost-tales.addran.name: Addran
hero.the-lost-tales.addran.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of allied Pikemen, Halberdiers, and Veteran Pikemen by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every level (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.balder.biography: Balder was an Enroth Necromancer specialised in Mummies transformation. Balder heard that many experiments were being conducted on a land called Deyja. His curiosity and thirst for knowledge were too great to resist going there to see for himself...
hero.the-lost-tales.balder.name: Balder
hero.the-lost-tales.balder.specialty.des: Transforms walking dead and Zombies into Mummies.
hero.the-lost-tales.bizz.biography: Bizz is an old air elemental who lived for a long time with the genies. They were the ones who taught her the art of war.
hero.the-lost-tales.bizz.name: Bizz
hero.the-lost-tales.bizz.specialty.descr: Increases the Speed of allied Air Elementals, Storm Elementals, and Great Air Elementals by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.bizz.specialty.name: Air Elem.
hero.the-lost-tales.bofmog.biography: Bofmog is Kilgor's personal executioner. On those few occasions when Kilgor didn't do the deed himself, he turned it over to silent, thoughtful Bofmog. Unknown to the mad king, however, Bofmog decided for himself who deserved to die. For those that didn't, he arranged an escape
hero.the-lost-tales.bofmog.name: Bofmog
hero.the-lost-tales.bofmog.specialty.des: receives a 5% per level bonus to his Armorer skill percentage.
hero.the-lost-tales.bruhl.biography: Brühl is a Kreegan general known for his cruelty. He has no pity for weakness, even among his own warriors...
hero.the-lost-tales.bruhl.name: Brühl
hero.the-lost-tales.bruhl.specialty.desc: Increases the speed of any Devils, Archdevils and Devil Reapers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.bruhl.specialty.name: devils
hero.the-lost-tales.dogwoggle.biography: Dogwoggle is a hapless hero who has a way of getting into trouble. He often brags about his abilities (which are questionable) and exhibits unflagging confidence no matter how often he fails. However, with his mindless persistence, he always manages to stumble out of trouble and come out on top.
hero.the-lost-tales.dogwoggle.name: Dogwoggle
Increases kingdom's ore and wood production by 1 per day.
hero.the-lost-tales.falagar.biography: After the succession Wars in Enroth, Falagar intended to enjoy a well-deserved retirement, but when the war against the Kreegan began, his aquatic affinity , naturally drew him to join the Conflux.
hero.the-lost-tales.falagar.name: Falagar
hero.the-lost-tales.falagar.specialty.de: Increases the damage of Water spells by 50%.
hero.the-lost-tales.farnivon.biography: Whenever a liaison with sprites is needed, carefree Farnivon is called because few people have the patience to put up with their practical jokes. For those who know Farnivon best, they have noticed that he is becoming more and more like the creatures he loves with each passing day.
hero.the-lost-tales.farnivon.name: Farnivon
hero.the-lost-tales.farnivon.specialty.d: Increases the Speed of allied Pixies and Sprites by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 10% for every 1 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.gelila.biography: Gelila is Brulh's sister. They are both young demons whose sole motivation is destruction. She is known for her cruelty and her pleasure in making her enemies suffer.
hero.the-lost-tales.gelila.name: Gelila
hero.the-lost-tales.gelila.specialty.des: Casts Frenzy with effect increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.the-lost-tales.gundross.biography: Unlike most of his race, Gundross is a master of adapting to new situations. In the event of unforeseen circumstances, he reacts with complete confidence in his ability to come up with a plan in an instant. This creative way of dealing with things has been his secret to success.
hero.the-lost-tales.gundross.name: Gundross
hero.the-lost-tales.gundross.specialty.d: Receives a 5% reduction to the cost of moving on rough terrain.
hero.the-lost-tales.ha'ora.biography: Ha'Ora is a broodmate of another famous witch, Voy. Their mother stole salt, a priceless commodity in Tatalia, from gorgon feeders and rubbed it on the eggs she laid, hoping for lizardmen as mighty as those fire-breathing bulls to hatch, but instead, her children developed an unorthodox interest in the salt water of the Enroth seas and long journeys.
hero.the-lost-tales.ha'ora.name: Ha'Ora
hero.the-lost-tales.ha'ora.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill percentage.
hero.the-lost-tales.halfor.biography: Balfor is a wild Dwarf who belongs to a clan of Dwarf Blacksmiths of the mountains. He can train every Dwarves into Mountain Dwarves.
hero.the-lost-tales.halfor.name: Balfor
hero.the-lost-tales.halfor.specialty.des: Transforms Dwarf, Battle Dwarf and Dwarf Enforcer into Dwarf Guard.
hero.the-lost-tales.hortos.biography: Hortos is the leader of the sedentary Avlee Centaurs.His title was bestowed upon him by his father, who had previously been the leader. It is therefore with great motivation that he strives day after day to live up to this title.
hero.the-lost-tales.hortos.name: Hortos
hero.the-lost-tales.hortos.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of allied Centaurs, Cnetaur Captains, and Centaur Archers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 10% for every level (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.hota-compatibility.A: Axus is a Water Elemental who chose not to live in the Plane Water. He prefers to live alongside the Sirens, Tritons, and Sea Serpents in the world's many seas. He is also the only one who can communicate with Sea Serpents and Haspids. This ability was discovered by Astra when she one day saw Axus with a Haspid. It was then that she asked him to guide these creatures in naval battles...
Increases the Speed of allied Sea Serpents and Haspids by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.hota-compatibility.a: Azimar is one of Regna's most famous Sea Dogs. It's said that he never misses his target, even when he's drunk... Tired of having to answer to anyone, Azimar decided to be his own captain.
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Archery skill percentage.
hero.the-lost-tales.hota-compatibility.b: Bianne has always been considered a genius. She was repairing automation systems at only 13 years old. It makes sense that now she's working on the most sophisticated machine in the factory.
Increases the Speed of allied Dreadnoughts, Juggernauts and Onslaughts by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.hota-compatibility.k: Karrul is the lieutenant of Tark, king of the Nix. He was sent to the cove to represent him there and lead the Nix during battles.
Increases the Speed of allied Nix and Nix Warriors by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.hota-compatibility.m: Mollur is one of the oldest Jotunn of his clan, his prowess in battle and his courage are known throughout Vori. He only has to give a war cry for all the Jotunn to follow him into battle, without asking a single question.
Increases the Speed of allied Jotuuns and Jotunn Warlords by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.hota-compatibility.s: Sandel was just a warrior without any particular talents, his only strength was his self-belief. When he saw the Couatls arrive at the Factory, he immediately understood that this was his chance to become someone important. Without hesitation, he began training them...
Increases the Speed of allied Couatls, Crimson Couatls and Quetzalcouatls by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.jojosh.biography: In his youth, Jojosh fought for warlords such as Lord Slayer and Archibald Ironfist. He crossed the great sea and the old barbarian saw his arrival in this new country as a chance for redemption before the end of his days.
hero.the-lost-tales.jojosh.name: Jojosh
hero.the-lost-tales.jojosh.specialty.des: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
hero.the-lost-tales.jubal.biography: Jubal's thunderous voice can be heard over the loudest battle or noisiest feast - two places where he's equally comfortable. Just about his only known weakness is his sense of hospitality. Jubal can't stand being accused of being crude or stingy, so he goes out of his way to prove the opposite.
hero.the-lost-tales.jubal.name: Jubal
hero.the-lost-tales.jubal.specialty.desc: Increases the speed of any Giants and Titans by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.jubal.specialty.name: Giants
hero.the-lost-tales.laine.biography: Laine almost became a priest, but his father convinced him to become a soldier in the Erathian military instead. As the eldest son, it was expected of him and he always does his duty. But to this day, he still regrets his choice and feels a spiritual emptiness inside.
hero.the-lost-tales.laine.name: Laine
hero.the-lost-tales.laine.specialty.desc: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill percentage.
hero.the-lost-tales.laine.specialty.name: Logistics
hero.the-lost-tales.lazar.biography: Lazar is an old Fire Elemental , he lives in the same realm as the Firebirds , the plane of fire. Lazar was called by the conflux because of his frienship to the Firebirds.
hero.the-lost-tales.lazar.name: Lazar
hero.the-lost-tales.lazar.specialty.desc: Increases the Speed of allied Firebirds and Phoenix, by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.lazar.specialty.name: Firebird
hero.the-lost-tales.marcius.biography: War dragged Marcius out of his mundane life as a farmer and into the exciting career of a soldier. Later, he was knighted and spent many years fighting in Queen Catherine's army, never complaining. What's a little hard work when you get to participate in some of the most exciting.
hero.the-lost-tales.marcius.name: Marcius
hero.the-lost-tales.marlous.biography: Marlous is an extremely obedient Gremlin. He accepted his slavery as if it were perfectly natural. His good fortune was to belong to a powerful mage who placed him at the head of a small army of Gremlins... Then his talents were recognized throughout Bracada as that of a powerful Gremlin leader...
hero.the-lost-tales.marlous.name: Marlous
hero.the-lost-tales.marlous.specialty.de: Increases the speed of any Gremlins, Master Gremlins and Assistant Gremlins by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 10% for every 1 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.maroth.biography: Maroth is one of the oldest death knights, he has fought many dragons and suffered many defeats... it was at this moment that he decided to turn their forces against them. In his madness, he had managed to fuse his bones with those of a skeleton dragon. It was after this evenement , with the help of many necromancers, he succeeded in resurrecting the dead dragons.
hero.the-lost-tales.maroth.name: Maroth
hero.the-lost-tales.maroth.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of allied Bone Dragon, Ghost Dragon and Dragon Lich by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.melina.biography: Strangely, few Medusas obtain the title of Overlord, but Melina achieved it through her great combat intelligence and ability to command the Medusas.
hero.the-lost-tales.melina.name: Melina
hero.the-lost-tales.melina.specialty.des: Increases the Speed of allied Medusas and Medusa Queens by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.nacron.biography: Nacron grew up near a Hydra Pond, these creatures always fascinated him with their power, no wonder he made them his specialty when he became a beastmaster...
hero.the-lost-tales.nacron.name: Nacron
hero.the-lost-tales.nacron.specialty.des: Increases the speed of any Hydras, Chaos Hydras and Flying Hydras by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.nanette.biography: Nanette made the worst mistake of her life when she let her parents talk her into joining the priesthood instead of marrying the man she loved. Now she has since lost contact with her love and she devotes herself entirely to her prayers...
hero.the-lost-tales.nanette.name: Nanette
hero.the-lost-tales.nanette.specialty.de: Casts Cure with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units).
hero.the-lost-tales.nicolaj.biography: Son of a famous blacksmith, Nicolaj thought he would follow in his father's footsteps, but he preferred to go into the armor and weapons trade. And that's how his talents were spotted by a general, who saw a good opportunity in wartime...
hero.the-lost-tales.nicolaj.name: Nicolaj
hero.the-lost-tales.nicolaj.specialty.de: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
hero.the-lost-tales.sarakin.biography: Sarakin studied magic in the Misty Islands and served Roland Ironfist during the succession Wars of Enroth. But while his loyalty was never questioned, his ruthless methods was frowned upon by his fellow Wizards. Sarakin is determined to craft a new reputation for himself in Bracada.
hero.the-lost-tales.sarakin.name: Sarakin
hero.the-lost-tales.sarakin.specialty.de: Casts Fireball with damage increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.the-lost-tales.sharah.biography: Sharah fell in love with a human wizard once. She lived a happy life with the man, but since she is an immortal genie, she watched her beloved grow old and pass away. Now, this somber genie tries to carry on with nothing left but her memories and a wish that she too had been mortal.
hero.the-lost-tales.sharah.name: Sharah
hero.the-lost-tales.sharah.specialty.des: Casts Weakness with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units).
hero.the-lost-tales.shudgoy.biography: Shudgoy is the greatest Doom Knight who ever existed. His talents are such that he can rival the formidable Dread Knights without being mounted... That is why he was asked to create and train an army of armored vampires.
hero.the-lost-tales.shudgoy.name: Shudgoy
hero.the-lost-tales.shudgoy.specialty.de: Increases the Speed of Doom Knights by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.silf.biography: During an attack by wild bears in the magic forest, Silf was saved by a Green Drgaon. Since then, he has held a deep admiration and a great friendship for this creature. With time other Dragons of the magic forest become friend with him. That is why he can now count on these dragons to help him on the battlefield.
hero.the-lost-tales.silf.name: Silf
hero.the-lost-tales.silf.specialty.descr: Increases the Speed of allied Green Dragon, Gold Dragons and Siver Dragons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 7 level (rounded up).
hero.the-lost-tales.silf.specialty.name: Green Dragon
hero.the-lost-tales.sirKentaine.biograph: Sir Kentaine was raised from a squire to a knight when he single-handedly saved the King’s life during an assassination attempt. His long career as the King’s Swordbearer soon became the subject of many tales, most of which state that Kentaine is the example of a perfect knight.
hero.the-lost-tales.sirKentaine.name: Sir Kentaine
hero.the-lost-tales.sirKentaine.specialt: Transforms Pikemen into Squires and Halberdiers, Veteran Pikemen into Man At Arms.
hero.the-lost-tales.slash.biography: Slash was an old drinking buddy of Crag Hack back in Enroth. He came to Erathia to hide from constables who wanted to question him about some peasants with whom he had a falling out. Once in Erathia he was promptly arrested for cheating at cards.
hero.the-lost-tales.slash.name: Slash
hero.the-lost-tales.slash.specialty.desc: receives a 5% per level bonus to his Armorer skill percentage.
hero.the-lost-tales.slash.specialty.name: Armorer
hero.the-lost-tales.tharj.biography: Over the past century, Tharj has taken part in most of the major battles that raged across the landscape of Antagarich, both as a mercenary and an officer in the armies of Erathia and AvLee. He is highly goal oriented, stiff, and stubborn.
hero.the-lost-tales.tharj.name: Tharj
hero.the-lost-tales.tharj.specialty.desc: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Archery skill percentage.
hero.the-lost-tales.tharj.specialty.name: Archery
hero.the-lost-tales.tyro.biography: Morglin Ironfist was once ambushed. An ogre named Tyro saved him and, for this, was knighted. After Morglin's death, Tyro decided to help Roland, Morglin's son, in his fratricidal war. After that, Tyro wanted to reconnect with his origins and decided to learn about the lives of the ogres in Krewlood.
hero.the-lost-tales.tyro.name: Tyro
hero.the-lost-tales.tyro.specialty.descr: receives a 5% per level bonus to his Offence skill percentage.
hero.the-lost-tales.tyro.specialty.name: Offence
hero.the-lost-tales.vatawna.biography: Vatawna has always been committed to defending nature and sacred groves throughout the world. For several centuries, she has participated in numerous wars, ranging from the defense of the forests in Jadame to the War of Succession in Enroth.
hero.the-lost-tales.vatawna.name: Vatawna
hero.the-lost-tales.vatawna.specialty.de: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Intelligence skill percentage.
hero.the-lost-tales.wyrm.biography: After his defeat during the assault on Noraston, Wyrm was forced to leave Enroth with his brother Rialdo. They decided to go to Deyja the land of the vampires , where a new king had just been autoproclaimed...
hero.the-lost-tales.wyrm.name: Wyrm
hero.the-lost-tales.wyrm.specialty.descr: Casts Slayer with effect increased by 20 for level 1–2 creatures, by 16 for level 3–4 creatures, by 12 for level 5–6 creatures, and by 8 for level 7 creatures.
hero.the-lost-tales.wyrm.specialty.name: Slayer
hero.the-lost-tales.yrami.biography: Unlike other gnolls, Yrami has always been curious about what was happening in other neighboring regions, and that is why he has formed bonds with all sorts of different people, from simple pirates to barbarian lords.
hero.the-lost-tales.yrami.name: Yrami
hero.the-lost-tales.yrami.specialty.desc: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
hero.the-lost-tales.yrami.specialty.name: +350 Gold
hero.the-lost-tales.zan.biography: Zan the dragon slayer is a veteran knight who learned the art of dragon slaying from a cult of Jadame... Only after drinking dragon blood do dragonslayers gain a certain resistance to magic. These dragon slayers use swords imbued with magic that allows them to inflict additional damage on dragons. Now he shares his talent with Erathia and trains all those who wish to learn this art in turn.
hero.the-lost-tales.zan.name: Zan
hero.the-lost-tales.zan.specialty.descri: Transforms Swordmen into Dragon Hunters and Crusaders, Vindicators into Dragon Slayers.
hero.the-lost-tales.zan.specialty.name: Dragonslayers
